title: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited — FDA 실사 관찰사항 API (실사 종료 2024-03-08)

source_summary: Written procedures are not established and followed for evaluations conducted at least annually to review records associated with a representative number of batches, whether approved or rejected.
